comparison.objective: Thread and close a two-part bent-foot U-lock around a bicycle rim and stand.
comparison.physical_skill: Rigid-object threading through spokes, angled socket insertion and pivoting latch engagement, not agitation and size-selective aperture passage.
comparison.success_condition: Lock must link rim and stand, latch at specified seating, be released and stable for 1 s. Candidate grades recovery fraction, washer retention, spill/damage, support placement and 3 s dwell. No material rubric details are missing.
comparison.reason: The shared use of two hands and controlled insertion is generic; locking two fixed objects tests topology and latch assembly, not bulk separation through a sieve.
